name: YouTube Grid Fix & Shorts Block
description: Sets videos per row to six by changing --ytd-rich-grid-items-per-row to 6 and --ytd-rich-grid-gutter-margin to 0px. Additionally targets via ytd-rich-shelf-renderer[is-shorts] and sets display to none to remove shorts. Requires an additional fix of setting the ytd-rich-item-renderer attribute items-per-row to 6 in order to account for the way the shorts shelf modifies the layout.
